description: VectorLake Performance and Quality Improvements - Update dependencies, improve performance, accuracy, structure and tests

userStories.title: Update project dependencies to latest versions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all project dependencies updated to their latest stable versions for security and performance improvements.
acceptanceCriteria: Update pyproject.toml with latest compatible versions of all dependencies
Run uv lock to update lockfile
Run uv sync --extra dev to verify installation
Run pytest to verify tests still pass

userStories.title: Update pre-commit hook versions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need pre-commit hooks updated to latest versions for better code quality checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Update .pre-commit-config.yaml with latest hook versions
Run pre-commit autoupdate or manually update versions
Run pre-commit run --all-files to verify hooks work
Commit updated configuration

userStories.title: Improve test structure with proper directory organization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests organized into unit, integration, and system directories for better maintainability.
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/unit/, tests/integration/, tests/system/ directories
Move existing unit tests to tests/unit/
Move property-based tests to tests/unit/
Move S3 tests to tests/integration/
Add __init__.py files to all test directories
Run pytest to verify all tests still pass

userStories.title: Add inline_snapshot tests for critical functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need snapshot tests for deterministic output verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Add inline-snapshot to dev dependencies
Create snapshot tests for LSH hash function with fixed seeds
Create snapshot tests for make_granularity function
Run pytest to verify tests pass

userStories.title: Optimize HNSW search performance with batch distance computation
userStories.description: As a user, I need faster vector search operations for better query performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimize vectorized_distance to use numpy broadcasting
Reduce memory allocations in search hot path
Run benchmarks to verify performance improvement
All existing tests must pass

userStories.title: Improve search accuracy with better HNSW parameters
userStories.description: As a user, I need more accurate nearest neighbor results.
acceptanceCriteria: Add recall test comparing against brute-force search
Tune HNSW parameters (m, ef) for better recall
Document parameter choices
Run tests to verify accuracy improvements
